page.notes: Page number "165" read at top right; the final digit is doubtful, hence [?]. Letter marks at the head of each column (left "ם", right "ס") are signature-like catchmarks, not a running head, and are left out. Hebrew forms are copied from a small, rubbed scan; every doubtful Hebrew form is marked [?]. The faint overprinted block at the foot of the right column (circumdabit eum, Deut. 32.10) is printed text, but it is blurred and partly overlaps the lines above. The entry "יִסְ[?]" (apprehendet) is not legible enough to read with confidence. Right column, line for "eorum": the Hebrew after the comma is uncertain. The fragment "3. f. m. R. נָסַב [?]" in the left column is a doubtful reading.
